detected_by: local CI simulation: fresh sparse oracle fetch + full 'cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast' root suite run with HOME hidden, matching CI env
impact: GitHub Actions runs 35050389421 and 35045137495 both failed 'Run core crate tests' in 'Publish tester release' on develop: PinnedTree::load panics in tests/sheet_rule_convert_gate.rs (7 tests) because CI has no oracle fetch step at all -- PR #391 only guarded one lib test, cargo test's wider run reached these. The control is the CI fetch step itself (not another one-off guard), added to publish-tester-release.yml, tranche-3-ci.yml, and a new pr-tests.yml that runs the same lane on every PR into develop so this class fails pre-merge next time.
resolution: Added the oracle-fetch step before cargo test in both workflows plus twin pr-tests.yml; widened PCGEN_ORACLE_SPARSE_PATHS to include data/darwins_world_2/.../terrors_of_twisted_earth for a real large-file perf fixture; fixed pcgen_gradle_wrapper_is_runnable (4 test files) to also require code/testsuite/base-xml.ftl, since cone-mode sparse checkout keeps root files like gradlew even without the code/ tree
summary: CI never fetched the pinned PCGen oracle; cargo test panicked on 7 oracle-reading tests, and once fixed by fetching, 5 more tests either panicked on a fixture outside the sparse cone or a guard that only checked gradlew's executable bit, not the code/ Gradle project it also needs
